production_upgrade.name: rule-world macro-to-micro grammar
rules: Open on a visible finance rule or state instead of an explanation.
Keep at least one persistent numeric or physical state across scene resets.
Every 2-3 second reset must transform the rule, obstacle, object, or character state.
High-concept hooks should show at least three distinct mechanic transformations before payoff.
When useful, start with a brief exaggerated big-picture framing, then snap into Dave, Chad, or Points Monk facing the concrete consequence.
Character action demonstrates the rule first; text labels or quantifies it second.
Resolve the rule physically on-screen instead of ending on a static summary card.
